target.title: [bug]: Remove redundant  type assertions in store.ts and row-codec.ts
target.body:
## Summary

- **Problem:** `src/cron/service/store.ts` and `src/cron/store/row-codec.ts` contain redundant `as unknown as` type assertions that reduce code readability and type safety
- **What changed:** Replaced 5 occurrences of `as unknown as X` with direct type annotations `: X` or simplified `as X`
- **What did NOT change:** Runtime behavior, type inference logic, test coverage
- **Net:** Cleaner type assertions with no behavior changes

## Change Type

- [x] Refactor

## Scope

- [x] Cron service (store.ts, row-codec.ts)

## Linked Issue

- Closes #99018

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

- None (type-only cleanup, no runtime behavior changes)

## Security Impact

- New permissions/capabilities? No · Secrets handling? No · Network calls? No · Tool exec surface? No · Data access scope? No

## Evidence

- Type check: `pnpm tsgo --noEmit` passes
- Test suite: `pnpm test src/cron/service/store.test.ts` 10 tests pass
- Test suite: `pnpm test src/cron/store/row-codec.schedule.test.ts` 4 tests pass
- Test suite: `pnpm test src/cron/service.*.test.ts` 218 tests pass

## Human Verification

- Verified: Type check passes, all related tests pass, git diff confirms only type assertion syntax changed
- Not verified: Manual end-to-end cron job execution (relying on automated test coverage)

## Compatibility / Migration

- Backward compatible? Yes · Config/env changes? No · Migration needed? No

## AI assistance

AI-assisted (Claude Code). Tested locally (type check, unit tests). Author understands the change.

## Risks and Mitigations

- Risk: Simplified type assertions could introduce subtle type errors
  - Mitigation: TypeScript compiler validation passes, 218 existing tests all pass, proving type inference is correct

---

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior or issue addressed:** Verify that removing redundant `as unknown as` type assertions in cron store loading and persistence code maintains correct type safety and runtime behavior without introducing regressions.

**Real environment tested:** Local OpenClaw development environment on Linux x86_64, Node.js v22.19.0 (as shown in pnpm install output), Cron scheduling subsystem.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
1. Applied code changes to `src/cron/service/store.ts` (lines 109, 158) and `src/cron/store/row-codec.ts` (lines 161, 167, 317).
2. Ran type check: `pnpm tsgo --noEmit`.
3. Ran store loading tests: `pnpm test src/cron/service/store.test.ts`.
4. Ran row-codec tests: `pnpm test src/cron/store/row-codec.schedule.test.ts`.
5. Ran comprehensive cron service tests: `pnpm test src/cron/service.*.test.ts`.
6. Verified git diff to confirm only type assertion syntax changed.

**Evidence after fix:**
```
$ pnpm tsgo --noEmit
$ pnpm tsgo:core --noEmit
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo --noEmit
[No output - type check passed]

$ pnpm test src/cron/service/store.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.cron.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 /media/vdc/seed-test/open-claw/openclaw


 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
   Start at  16:34:03
   Duration  17.15s (transform 13.39s, setup 1.50s, import 14.91s, tests 336ms, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 31.45s

$ pnpm test src/cron/store/row-codec.schedule.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.cron.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 /media/vdc/seed-test/open-claw/openclaw


 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
   Start at  16:36:19
   Duration  1.41s (transform 573ms, setup 492ms, import 504ms, tests 122ms, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 13.08s

$ pnpm test src/cron/service.*.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.cron.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 /media/vdc/seed-test/open-claw/openclaw


 Test Files  31 passed (31)
      Tests  218 passed (218)
   Start at  16:36:37
   Duration  28.11s (transform 4.48s, setup 927ms, import 15.91s, tests 10.76s, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 40.54s
```

**Observed result after fix:** 
- Type check (`pnpm tsgo --noEmit`) completes with no errors, confirming TypeScript accepts the simplified type assertions
- Store loading tests: 10/10 pass, verifying cron store load/persist behavior unchanged
- Row-codec tests: 4/4 pass, verifying schedule identity extraction works correctly
- Comprehensive service tests: 218/218 pass, covering all cron service scenarios including issue regressions, delivery plans, job scheduling, and store operations
- Git diff confirms only type assertion syntax changed, no logic modifications

**What was not tested:** 
- No manual verification of actual cron job execution in a running OpenClaw instance (relying on automated test coverage)
- No cross-platform testing on Windows or macOS (only Linux x86_64 tested)
- No performance benchmarking with large cron store files (1000+ jobs)
- No testing with different Node.js versions beyond the current v22.19.0
